name: Vantage DUB1 campus, Profile Park, Grange Castle, Dublin
notes: Vantage announced a EUR1bn DUB1 campus at Profile Park with 52MW of IT capacity across two initial phases; phase one was expected online by end-2024.

name: Echelon DUB20 campus, Kish Business Park, Arklow, County Wicklow
notes: Echelon said work had begun at DUB20; DCD reports the campus will eventually provide 200MW IT capacity, with 90MW in phase one.

name: Echelon DUB30 campus, Kish Business Park, Arklow, County Wicklow
notes: Wicklow County Council granted conditional planning permission for three data center buildings on the north end of Kish Business Park; described as another 100MW Echelon development in Arklow.

name: Amazon Drogheda IDA Business & Technology Park campus, County Meath
developer: Amazon Web Services / CAP Developments LLC
notes: An Bord Pleanala allowed the challenged Drogheda development to proceed; DCD reports three proposed data centers using 48MW each, for 144MW maximum campus capacity.

name: AWS Bord na Mona Eco Energy Park data centers, County Offaly
developer: Amazon Web Services / Bord na Mona
notes: Bord na Mona announced AWS as first business to join its Midlands Eco Energy Park, creating a pathway for AWS to develop data centres powered by wind and solar energy; specifications and timeline not disclosed.

name: Google Dublin data centre campus, Profile Park / Grange Castle, Dublin
notes: Google's official Dublin data center page states it purchased land and an existing building in 2011, opened the first Dublin data centre in 2012, and announced a second data centre in 2014.

name: Meta Clonee Data Centre expansion, County Meath
notes: Meta announced two additional buildings at Clonee, bringing the facility to nearly 150,000 square meters; DCD separately reported in 2024 that Meta had permission for emergency diesel backup generators at Clonee.

name: Digital Realty DUB3, Grange Castle Business Park, Dublin
notes: Digital Realty's facility page lists DUB3 at Grange Castle Business Park, Nangor Road, Dublin, with 59,202 sq ft / 5,500 sq m total building size and current compliance and sustainability details.

name: Backweston shared Government Data Centre, Celbridge, County Kildare
notes: EU recovery project page describes a shared Government Data Centre at Backweston with EUR40m grant funding; DCD reports construction completed in July 2025 and operations set to begin in 2026.

name: Herbata Naas data center campus, Jigginstown/Halverstown/Newhall, County Kildare
notes: Kildare County Council granted permission for six two-storey data center buildings near Naas; DCD reports each building offers 30MW, for 180MW at full buildout, though appeals were expected.

name: Pure DC Dublin campus, Ballycoolin, Dublin
notes: Pure DC's DUB01 has been operational since 2024; DCD reports the Ballycoolin campus is designed to deliver 54MW across DUB01, DUB02, and DUB03, with a 110MW on-site microgrid and a possible 90MW future expansion subject to permitting and power.

name: JCD EPark DC1, Little Island, Cork
notes: JCD says shell and core construction of DC1 is complete, the building is 86,000 sq ft, and 12MW of grid capacity has been secured and will be made live in 2026.

name: JCD EPark DC2, Little Island, Cork
notes: JCD says EPark has full planning permission for DC2, a 99,000 sq ft single-storey data centre with site clearance complete and 10MW electrical grid capacity.

name: JCD EPark DC3, Little Island, Cork
notes: JCD says EPark has full planning permission for DC3, a 323,000 sq ft double-storey data centre, with site clearance complete and a 60MW grid connection pending.

name: Art Data Centres Ennis campus, Tulla Road, County Clare
notes: An Bord Pleanala approved a EUR1.2bn Ennis campus despite appeals; DCD reports six data halls on 145 acres / 1.3m sq ft with up to 200MW and work expected to commence later in 2024. A later judicial-review challenge was dismissed.

name: AVAIO Orion / Killala Data Centre campus, Killala Business Park, County Mayo
notes: Mayo County Council conditionally approved the project on April 25, 2025, but an appeal filed May 21 delayed it; DCD reports a two-storey 36MW facility with 29,075 sq m gross floor area.

name: Apple Athenry data centre, Derrydonnell, County Galway
notes: MKO describes Apple's planned EUR850m multi-phase Athenry development; DCD reports Ireland's High Court overruled the planning-permission extension in 2022, meaning Apple would need to reapply.

name: Airwire DC Galway, Lyrr Building, Mervue Industrial Estate, Galway
notes: Airwire's own about page says it operates a small data center in Galway City; Baxtel lists Airwire DC Galway as operational and indicates 1MW for the operator.

name: Stryve Data Center, Gray House, Galway Technology Park, Parkmore, Galway
notes: DataCenterMap lists Stryve Data Center at Gray House, Galway Technology Park, Parkmore, Galway; search snippet reports 5MW capacity.

name: GreenScale / Atlantic Hub Letterkenny campus, County Donegal
notes: GreenScale's launch statement says Atlantic Hub includes prime locations in Derry and Donegal totaling 170MW; DCD reports a 100MW campus planned at Letterkenny Technology Park in County Donegal, with no development timeline shared.
